regions.merged_text: I hope you are all well. It is about three years, perhaps four, since I read one of your letters to Fr. Maurice and forwarded to me. I enrolled you both in the Seraphic Mass Association at that time. I had everything ready to send you the certificate but mislaid address or something and never sent it. Please pardon my neglect. I was thankful to God, however, to learn afterwards that things brightened up and especially that O. J. stopped drinking. I was not surprised that such was the case: for we have reports almost every day of remarkable favors. I have just read Martha's letter of the 14th in which she laments conditions again going .. ?? ? I am again enrolling you and sending you certificate, etc. I hope it will help. I rather fear none of you are what you ought to be in regards to frequent and dayly communion. Why do you not all take a lesson from John F.C's example. . What a consolation for me, when I got the telegram (January 26 - 1929), to know that he had been receiving every day - and Tom at least every week! Thanks be to God! .. But what must it have been to them when they awoke in Eternity ?! · . . And 0! .. "To-morrow is eternity" for each of us.
